name: gian
description: One local desktop app for Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, and Grok Build

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @gian/shared build && pnpm -F @gian/proxy-protocol build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.canary:attachment:claude: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/cc-proxy build && node scripts/run-provider-attachment-canary.mjs --provider claude
scripts.canary:attachment:codex: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/codex-proxy build && node scripts/run-provider-attachment-canary.mjs --provider codex
scripts.canary:attachment:kimi: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/host build && pnpm --filter @gian/kimi-proxy build && node scripts/run-provider-attachment-canary.mjs --provider kimi
scripts.canary:attachment:grok: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/host build && pnpm --filter @gian/grok-proxy build && node scripts/run-provider-attachment-canary.mjs --provider grok
scripts.canary:codex-compat: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/codex-proxy build && node scripts/run-codex-compat-canary.mjs
scripts.canary:codex-steer: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/codex-proxy build && node scripts/run-codex-steer-canary.mjs
scripts.canary:kimi-store-compat: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/host build && node scripts/run-kimi-store-preflight.mjs
scripts.canary:kimi-lifecycle: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/host build && pnpm --filter @gian/kimi-proxy build && node scripts/run-kimi-lifecycle-canary.mjs
scripts.release:proxies: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/proxy-protocol build && pnpm --filter @gian/cc-proxy build && pnpm --filter @gian/codex-proxy build && pnpm --filter @gian/kimi-proxy build && pnpm --filter @gian/grok-proxy build && node scripts/build-proxy-artifacts.mjs
